intro.text: A noblewoman of the Western Dominance and the mother of Allrianne.

items.text: She was the wife of Ashweather Cett and had two children, Allrianne and Gneorndin. Although the family lived in Fadrex City, she schooled Allrianne in the manners of the Luthadel court, and Allrianne came to believe she was being shaped into an attractive bride who could serve her father's ambitions.
